item.description: Needle 2 is an open 45M-parameter model from cactus-compute for tool calling, device use, and structured extraction, shipping as a single 14MB binary that runs a full session in roughly 28MB of RAM. The pip-installable package supports LoRA fine-tuning and offline inference, making it a strong fit for phones, wearables, and robots.
